---
title: "VAE Latent Coordinates Boxplot (Lite)"
subtitle: "Parameterized by threshold (default: 8)"
params:
  threshold: 8
---

## Overview

Boxplot visualizations for VAE latent coordinates comparing dementia categories for threshold `r params$threshold`. Includes t-tests vs stable_normal and ANOVA for multi-category comparisons.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(ggh4x, install = FALSE)
source(here("custom_func/p_value_label.R"))

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

embedding <- read_rds(here(glue("VAE/lite/output/embedding_threshold_{params$threshold}.rds")))

vae_long <- embedding |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = vae_1:vae_6,
    names_to = "vae_dir",
    values_to = "vae_value"
  )

glimpse(vae_long)
```

## T-test: Dementia Categories vs stable_normal

```{r}
#| label: compute-ttest

ttest_result <- list()

for (dc in str_subset(unique(vae_long$demcat), "^stable_normal$", negate = TRUE)) {
  ttest_result[[dc]] <-
    vae_long |>
    filter(demcat %in% c("stable_normal", dc)) |>
    summarise(
      t = t.test(vae_value ~ demcat)$statistic,
      p = t.test(vae_value ~ demcat)$p.value,
      .by = vae_dir
    )
}

ttest_result <-
  ttest_result |>
  bind_rows(.id = "demcat") |>
  mutate(
    # House style (custom_func/p_value_label.R); quoted numbers keep their trailing zeros
    label = p_value_label(p),
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "stable_normal", "normal2mci", "stable_mci",
                         "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia")
  )

ttest_result
```

## ANOVA

```{r}
#| label: compute-anova

anova_result <-
  vae_long |>
  summarise(
    p = anova(lm(vae_value ~ demcat))$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    .by = vae_dir
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label = p_value_label(p)
  )

anova_result
```

## Boxplot Function

```{r}
#| output: false

make_boxplot_vae <- function(.data, text_size = 4, stat_result = ttest_result, ...) {
  .data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = demcat, y = vae_value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, notch = TRUE) +
    geom_text(
      data = stat_result,
      aes(label = label),
      x = I(0.5), y = I(0.95),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
      color = "darkred", size = text_size, size.unit = "pt",
      parse = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~vae_dir, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Dementia category", y = "VAE latent value")
}
```

## Initialize Boxplot List

```{r}
#| output: false

boxplot_list <- list()
```


## All Dementia Categories Grid

```{r}
#| label: prepare-all-demcat

dementia_categories <-
  vae_long |>
  pull(demcat) |>
  unique() |>
  discard(\(x) x == "stable_normal")

demcat_skeleton <-
  tibble(
    demcat_grand = rep(dementia_categories, 2),
    demcat_sub = c(as.character(dementia_categories), rep("stable_normal", length(dementia_categories)))
  ) |>
  mutate(demcat_sub = fct_relevel(demcat_sub, levels(demcat_grand))) |>
  arrange(demcat_grand, demcat_sub)

boxplot_data_all_demcat_together <-
  demcat_skeleton |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    data = vae_long %>%
      select(subject_id, demcat, vae_dir, vae_value) %>%
      filter(demcat == demcat_sub) |>
      lst()
  ) |>
  unnest(data) |>
  mutate(demcat_sub = fct_collapse(
    demcat_sub,
    stable_normal = "stable_normal",
    non_normal = c("normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia")
  ))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplot-all-demcat
#| fig.width: 11
#| fig.height: 11

boxplot_list$all_demcat <-
  boxplot_data_all_demcat_together |>
  ggplot(aes(x = demcat_sub, y = vae_value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, notch = TRUE) +
  geom_text(
    data = ttest_result %>% rename(demcat_grand = demcat),
    aes(label = label),
    x = I(0.5), y = I(0.95),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    color = "darkred", size = 6, size.unit = "pt",
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(demcat_grand), cols = vars(vae_dir), scales = "free_y", independent = "y") +
  labs(x = "Dementia category", y = "VAE latent value")

boxplot_list$all_demcat
```

## All Dimensions Boxplot

```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplot-all-dim
#| fig.width: 18
#| fig.height: 6

vae_displayed <- glue("vae_{1:6}")

vae_ordered <- anova_result |>
  filter(vae_dir %in% vae_displayed) |>
  arrange(p) |>
  pull(vae_dir)

all_dim_base <-
  vae_long |>
  filter(vae_dir %in% vae_displayed) |>
  mutate(
    vae_dir = factor(vae_dir, levels = vae_ordered),
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2mci", "stable_normal", "stable_mci",
                         "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = demcat, y = vae_value)) +
  geom_boxplot(notch = TRUE, outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    data = anova_result |>
      filter(vae_dir %in% vae_displayed) |>
      mutate(vae_dir = factor(vae_dir, levels = vae_ordered)),
    aes(label = label),
    x = I(0.5), y = I(0.95),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    color = "darkred", size = 6, size.unit = "pt",
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Dementia category", y = "VAE latent value")

boxplot_list$one_dim_all_1row <-
  all_dim_base + facet_wrap(~vae_dir, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y")

boxplot_list$one_dim_all_2row <-
  all_dim_base + facet_wrap(~vae_dir, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y")

boxplot_list$one_dim_all_1row
boxplot_list$one_dim_all_2row
```

## Selected Dimensions

Show the 4 most significant dimensions based on ANOVA p-values.

```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplot-selected-dim
#| fig.width: 14
#| fig.height: 6

vae_selected <- anova_result |>
  arrange(p) |>
  slice_head(n = 4) |>
  pull(vae_dir)

selected_dim_base <-
  vae_long |>
  filter(vae_dir %in% vae_selected) |>
  mutate(
    vae_dir = factor(vae_dir, levels = vae_selected),
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2mci", "stable_normal", "stable_mci",
                         "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = demcat, y = vae_value)) +
  geom_boxplot(notch = TRUE, outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    data = anova_result |>
      filter(vae_dir %in% vae_selected) |>
      mutate(vae_dir = factor(vae_dir, levels = vae_selected)),
    aes(label = label),
    x = I(0.5), y = I(0.95),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    color = "darkred", size = 6, size.unit = "pt",
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Dementia category", y = "VAE latent value")

boxplot_list$one_dim_selected_1row <-
  selected_dim_base + facet_wrap(~vae_dir, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y")

boxplot_list$one_dim_selected_2row <-
  selected_dim_base + facet_wrap(~vae_dir, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y")

boxplot_list$one_dim_selected_1row
boxplot_list$one_dim_selected_2row
```

## ANOVA Bar Plot

```{r}
#| label: fig-anova-vae

boxplot_list$anova_vae <-
  anova_result |>
  mutate(nlog10_p = -log10(p)) |>
  mutate(vae_dir = fct_reorder(vae_dir, p, .desc = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = nlog10_p, y = vae_dir)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10, size.unit = "pt", parse = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = "-log10(ANOVA p-value)", y = "VAE dimension")

boxplot_list$anova_vae
```

## Save Boxplots

```{r}
#| output: false

fig_dir <- here("VAE/lite/latent_coordinates/output/fig_tbl")
fs::dir_create(fig_dir)

save_variants <- list(
  one_dim_all_1row      = list(w = 18, h = 4),
  one_dim_all_2row      = list(w = 10, h = 6),
  one_dim_selected_1row = list(w = 14, h = 4),
  one_dim_selected_2row = list(w = 8,  h = 6)
)

iwalk(save_variants, \(dims, name) {
  ggsave(
    here(fig_dir, glue("fig_{name}_threshold_{params$threshold}.png")),
    plot = boxplot_list[[name]],
    width = dims$w, height = dims$h,
    device = grDevices::png, dpi = 300
  )
  write_rds(boxplot_list[[name]], here(fig_dir, glue("fig_{name}_threshold_{params$threshold}.rds")))
})

write_rds(boxplot_list, here(fig_dir, glue("boxplot_list_threshold_{params$threshold}.rds")))
```
